FROM region r
JOIN party p ON r.Region_ID = p.Region_ID
WHERE r.region_description_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "The strategic and economic significance of the region has been pivotal in its development.") AND r.k = 10

           UNION
           SELECT MIN(distance) FROM (SELECT distance FROM party WHERE party_description_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "A political party known for its emphasis on social reform and economic development.") LIMIT 10));

sql:
WITH RankedJournals AS (
    SELECT 
        j.Journal_ID AS Journal_ID, 
        j.Sales AS Sales, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY j.Sales DESC) AS SalesRank
    FROM 
        journal j
),
TopEditors AS (
    SELECT 
        jc.Editor_ID AS Editor_ID,
        e.Name AS Name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rj.Journal_ID) AS NumberOfTopJournals
    FROM 
        RankedJournals rj
    JOIN 
        journal_committee jc ON toString(rj.Journal_ID) = toString(jc.Journal_ID)
    JOIN 
        editor e ON toString(jc.Editor_ID) = toString(e.Editor_ID)
    WHERE 
        rj.SalesRank <= 5  
    GROUP BY 
        jc.Editor_ID, e.Name
    ORDER BY 
        NumberOfTopJournals DESC
)
SELECT 
    te.Name AS Name
FROM 
    TopEditors te
LIMIT 1;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Deep Learning') AS ref_vec_0,

similar_papers AS (
    SELECT p.paperId, p.title, p.numCitedBy, p.numCiting, distance(p.title_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM paper p
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

citation_analysis AS (
    SELECT sp.paperId, 
             sp.title AS title,
             sp.numCitedBy AS numCitedBy,
             (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cite c WHERE c.citingPaperId = sp.paperId) AS numTimesCited
      FROM similar_papers sp
)

SELECT ca.paperId, ca.title, ca.numTimesCited
FROM citation_analysis ca
ORDER BY ca.numTimesCited DESC, ca.numCitedBy DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'recent medical check-up') AS ref_vec_0,

Recent_Service AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.resident_id AS resident_id, 
        rs.service_id AS service_id, 
        rs.date_requested AS date_requested,
        s.organization_id, distance(rs.other_details_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM 
        Residents_Services rs
      JOIN 
        Services s ON toString(rs.service_id) = toString(s.service_id)
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

Resident_Organization AS (
    SELECT 
        r.resident_id AS resident_id, 
        r.property_id AS property_id, 
        o.organization_id AS organization_id
      FROM 
        Residents r
      JOIN 
        Organizations o ON toString(r.resident_id) = toString(o.parent_organization_id)
)

SELECT 
  ro.resident_id AS resident_id
FROM 
  Resident_Organization ro
JOIN 
  Recent_Service rs ON toString(ro.resident_id) = toString(rs.resident_id)
WHERE 
  ro.organization_id = rs.organization_id
LIMIT 1;

Here, the concept is "recent medical check-up", and the search retrieves the top 5 most similar service requests using vector embeddings. The embeddings translate textual content into numeric vectors where similarity is gauged by Euclidean distance (L2 norm). The closer the distance, the higher the similarity, allowing the system to infer relatedness beyond exact keyword matches.

      ORDER BY Association_Count DESC

This similarity is usually determined by calculating the Euclidean distance (L2 norm) between vectors, where a smaller distance indicates higher similarity. WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Home loan for customer with high credit score.') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Customer with multiple loans and high balance.') AS ref_vec_1,

loan_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(loan_description_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM loan

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

customer_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(customer_description_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM customer
    WHERE customer_description_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Customer with multiple loans
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

CTE_Loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_ID, 
        loan_type,
        cust_ID, 
        branch_ID, 
        amount,
        distance AS loan_distance
      FROM loan_filtered AS loan
),

CTE_Customers AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_ID, 
        cust_name, 
        acc_type, 
        acc_bal, 
        branch_ID,
        credit_score,
        distance AS customer_distance
      FROM customer_filtered AS customer high balance.')
)

SELECT 
  C.cust_name AS cust_name
FROM 
  CTE_Loans L
JOIN 
  CTE_Customers C ON toString(L.cust_ID) = toString(C.cust_ID)
WHERE 
  C.credit_score > 700
ORDER BY 
  C.customer_distance AS customer_distance
LIMIT 1;

    SELECT CID, distance(Course.Course_description_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance

SELECT e.StuID, c.CName
FROM Enrolled_in e
JOIN CourseMatch cm ON toString(e.CID) = toString(cm.CID)
JOIN Course c ON toString(e.CID) = toString(c.CID)
JOIN Minor_in mi ON toString(e.StuID) = toString(mi.StuID)

ORDER BY cm.distance
LIMIT 10;

The search utilizes embeddings to measure similarity, typically calculated with Euclidean distance, where lower values suggest higher similarity. The `k=5` parameter specifies that we are interested in the top 5 courses that align most closely with the advanced data structures and algorithms concept.

p_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(product_description_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM ProductSimilarity

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

a_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(address_details_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM Addresses

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
),

dr_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(other_route_details_embedding, ref_vec_2) AS distance
    FROM Delivery_Routes

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 2
),

ProductSimilarity AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, distance
      FROM p_filtered AS p
),

AddressSimilarity AS (
    SELECT a.address_id, distance
      FROM a_filtered AS a
),

RouteSimilarity AS (
    SELECT dr.route_id, distance
      FROM dr_filtered AS dr
)

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name
FROM ProductSimilarity p
JOIN Regular_Order_Products rop ON toString(p.product_id) = toString(rop.product_id)
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON toString(rop.regular_order_id) = toString(ro.regular_order_id)
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON toString(ro.regular_order_id) = toString(ao.regular_order_id)
JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON toString(ao.actual_order_id) = toString(od.actual_order_id)
JOIN AddressSimilarity ads ON toString(od.location_code) = toString(ads.address_id)
JOIN RouteSimilarity rs ON toString(rs.route_id) = toString(od.location_code)
WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'completed'
ORDER BY p.distance;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'A university that opened in the early 2000s in a coastal area') AS ref_vec_0,

SimilarCampuses AS (
    SELECT c.Id, c.Campus, c.Location, c.County, distance(c.Campuses_description_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM Campuses c
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)

SELECT 
  sc.Campus AS Campus, 
  sc.Location AS Location, 
  e.TotalEnrollment_AY AS YearlyEnrollment, 
  d.Degrees AS YearlyDegrees, 
  AVG(f.Faculty) AS AvgFaculty
FROM 
  SimilarCampuses sc
JOIN 
  enrollments e ON toString(sc.Id) = toString(e.Campus)
JOIN

WITH ManufacturerDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        m.Manufacturer_ID AS Manufacturer_ID, 
        m.Name AS Manufacturer_Name, 
        m.Num_of_Factories AS Num_of_Factories, 
        m.Num_of_Shops AS Num_of_Shops
    FROM manufacturer m
), FurnitureDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        f.Furniture_ID AS Furniture_ID,
        f.Name AS Furniture_Name,
        f.Num_of_Component AS Num_of_Component,
        f.Market_Rate AS Market_Rate
    FROM furniture f
), LatestManufacturerFurniture AS (
    SELECT 
        fm.Manufacturer_ID AS Manufacturer_ID, 
        fm.Furniture_ID AS Furniture_ID,
        fm.Price_in_Dollar AS Price_in_Dollar
    FROM furniture_manufacte fm
    INNER JOIN ManufacturerDetails md ON toString(fm.Manufacturer_ID) = toString(md.Manufacturer_ID)
    WHERE fm.Price_in_Dollar > 1000  
), CombinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        lm.Manufacturer_ID AS Manufacturer_ID,
        lm.Furniture_ID AS Furniture_ID,
        md.Manufacturer_Name AS Manufacturer_Name,
        fd.Furniture_Name AS Furniture_Name,
        lm.Price_in_Dollar AS Price_in_Dollar,
        fd.Market_Rate AS Market_Rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lm.Manufacturer_ID ORDER BY lm.Price_in_Dollar DESC) AS rn
    FROM LatestManufacturerFurniture lm
    INNER JOIN ManufacturerDetails md ON toString(lm.Manufacturer_ID) = toString(md.Manufacturer_ID)
    INNER JOIN FurnitureDetails fd ON toString(lm.Furniture_ID) = toString(fd.Furniture_ID)
)


SELECT Manufacturer_Name
FROM CombinedData
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY Manufacturer_Name;

ExpiringCertifications AS (
    SELECT Physician, CertificationExpires
      FROM Trained_In
      WHERE CertificationExpires BETWEEN now() AND date_add(DAY, 30, now())
),

SimilarPatients AS (
    SELECT SSN, distance(Patient.Patient_description_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM Patient
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 1
),

FilteredPhysicians AS (
    SELECT p.EmployeeID, p.Name, aw.Department, ec.CertificationExpires
      FROM Physician p
      JOIN Affiliated_With aw ON toString(p.EmployeeID) = toString(aw.Physician) AND aw.PrimaryAffiliation = 1
      JOIN ExpiringCertifications ec ON toString(p.EmployeeID) = toString(ec.Physician)
)

SELECT fp.Name
FROM FilteredPhysicians fp
JOIN SimilarPatients sp ON toString(fp.EmployeeID) = toString(sp.SSN)
ORDER BY sp.distance
LIMIT 1;

      FROM b_filtered AS b

      FROM TitleMatch tm
      JOIN DescriptionMatch dm ON toString(tm.Book_ID) = toString(dm.Book_ID)

SELECT p.Publisher, AVG(p.Price) AS Average_Price
FROM MatchedBooks mb

ORDER BY Average_Price DESC;

WITH ActiveCards AS (
    SELECT 
        card_id,
        customer_id
    FROM 
        Customers_Cards
    WHERE 
        date_valid_to > now()
),


RecentTransactions AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.transaction_id AS transaction_id,
        ft.account_id AS account_id,
        ft.card_id AS card_id,
        ft.transaction_date AS transaction_date,
        ft.transaction_amount AS transaction_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ft.card_id ORDER BY ft.transaction_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN 
        ActiveCards ac ON toString(ft.card_id) = toString(ac.card_id)
),


CustomerAccounts AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
        a.account_id AS account_id,
        a.account_name AS account_name
    FROM 
        Customers c
    JOIN 
        Accounts a ON toString(c.customer_id) = toString(a.customer_id)
)


SELECT 
    ca.full_name AS full_name,
    rt.transaction_amount AS transaction_amount
FROM 
    RecentTransactions rt
JOIN 
    CustomerAccounts ca ON toString(rt.account_id) = toString(ca.account_id)
WHERE 
    rt.rn = 1
ORDER BY 
    ca.full_name;
